Bae Jun-ho.summary: Bae Jun-ho is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Stoke City who adds half-turn receiving, tight-space passing, and final-third invention.
Bae Jun-ho.note: Watch Bae for receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. The clearest example is how he opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. In a different phase, Bae draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Bae Jun-ho.noteZh: 狭小空间接球前就想好下一步是理解Bae Jun-ho踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。到了另一个比赛环节，他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Cho Gue-sung.summary: Cho Gue-sung is a South Korea centre-forward from FC Midtjylland who gives the national team aerial presence, hold-up play, and penalty-box finishing.
Cho Gue-sung.note: Cho stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. Another aspect is how Cho protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Cho Gue-sung.noteZh: 看Cho Gue-sung的作用，关键是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Cho Wi-je.summary: Cho Wi-je is a South Korea centre-back from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds size, man-marking, and aerial defending to the squad.
Cho Wi-je.note: The key to Cho is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. A separate part of his game is how Cho moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Cho Wi-je.noteZh: 球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动构成Cho Wi-je踢法的核心。他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。除此之外，值得留意他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Eom Ji-sung.summary: Eom Ji-sung is a South Korea winger from Swansea City who adds one-on-one dribbling, inside carries, and bench attacking tempo.
Eom Ji-sung.note: Watch Eom for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Elsewhere, Eom uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Eom Ji-sung.noteZh: Eom Ji-sung的优势在于变向时仍把球控制在脚下。最直接的表现是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Hwang Hee-chan.summary: Hwang Hee-chan is a South Korea forward from Wolverhampton Wanderers who adds explosive pressing, channel running, and direct penalty-box threat.
Hwang Hee-chan.note: Hwang's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. Watch how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He also moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Hwang Hee-chan.noteZh: 最能体现Hwang Hee-chan特点的是看到空当后的爆发速度。这一点直接体现在他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。除此之外，他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Hwang In-beom.summary: Hwang In-beom is a South Korea midfielder from Feyenoord who gives the national team build-up passing, pressure resistance, and set-piece quality.
Hwang In-beom.note: What separates Hwang is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Hwang plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. At another point, he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Hwang In-beom.noteZh: Hwang In-beom的优势在于用传球的力度和角度移动防线。最直接的表现是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。另一个值得观察的细节是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Jens Castrop.summary: Jens Castrop is a South Korea central midfielder from Borussia Mönchengladbach who adds Bundesliga intensity, duel pressure, and two-way running.
Jens Castrop.note: Castrop's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Watch how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. At another point in the move, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Jens Castrop.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Jens Castrop踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Jo Hyeon-woo.summary: Jo Hyeon-woo is a South Korea goalkeeper from Ulsan HD who adds reflex saves, tournament experience, and command of the box.
Jo Hyeon-woo.note: Jo stands out for keeping his body shape compact for reflex saves at close range. He keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled. Jo also leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Jo Hyeon-woo.noteZh: 理解Jo Hyeon-woo，要先看近距离反应扑救时保持紧凑身体姿态。他会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Kim Jin-gyu.summary: Kim Jin-gyu is a South Korea central midfielder from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds simple circulation, late support, and domestic rhythm.
Kim Jin-gyu.note: For Kim, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A separate point is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Kim Jin-gyu.noteZh: 压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定是理解Kim Jin-gyu踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。到了另一个比赛环节，他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Kim Min-jae.summary: Kim Min-jae is a South Korea centre-back from Bayern Munich who gives the national team elite defending, recovery speed, and line-breaking passes.
Kim Min-jae.note: The key to Kim is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Elsewhere in the game, Kim holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kim Min-jae.noteZh: 最能体现Kim Min-jae特点的是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。这一点直接体现在他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。除此之外，他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Kim Moon-hwan.summary: Kim Moon-hwan is a South Korea right-back from Daejeon Hana Citizen who adds overlap timing, wide defending, and tournament experience.
Kim Moon-hwan.note: The key to Kim is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Elsewhere in the game, Kim gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Kim Moon-hwan.noteZh: 最能体现Kim Moon-hwan特点的是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。这一点直接体现在他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，他也会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Kim Seung-gyu.summary: Kim Seung-gyu is a South Korea goalkeeper from FC Tokyo who brings experience, distribution, and shot-stopping command.
Kim Seung-gyu.note: Watch Kim for turning a save into the first pass of an attack. The clearest example is how he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. Elsewhere, Kim keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Kim Seung-gyu.noteZh: 看Kim Seung-gyu的作用，关键是把一次扑救变成进攻第一传。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Kim Tae-hyeon.summary: Kim Tae-hyeon is a South Korea defender from Kashima Antlers who adds left-footed centre-back cover, recovery defending, and aerial strength.
Kim Tae-hyeon.note: Kim stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. Kim also meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Kim Tae-hyeon.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Kim Tae-hyeon踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Lee Dong-gyeong.summary: Lee Dong-gyeong is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Ulsan HD who adds left-footed passing, shooting range, and between-lines creativity.
Lee Dong-gyeong.note: For Lee, the foundation is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Look first at how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Beyond that, watch how he plays the available pass with his left foot.
Lee Dong-gyeong.noteZh: Lee Dong-gyeong的比赛建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球之上。首先看他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个方面是他会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。

Lee Gi-hyuk.summary: Lee Gi-hyuk is a South Korea defender from Gangwon FC who adds left-footed centre-back play, composure, and flexible build-up options.
Lee Gi-hyuk.note: Lee's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Away from that moment, he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Lee Gi-hyuk.noteZh: 最能体现Lee Gi-hyuk特点的是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。这一点直接体现在他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Lee Han-beom.summary: Lee Han-beom is a South Korea centre-back from FC Midtjylland who adds European experience, aerial defending, and recovery power.
Lee Han-beom.note: What separates Lee is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. Lee turns early and protects the route toward goal. A separate detail appears when he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Lee Han-beom.noteZh: Lee Han-beom的比赛建立在第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位之上。首先看他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Lee Jae-sung.summary: Lee Jae-sung is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Mainz 05 who adds pressing intelligence, link play, and late box arrivals.
Lee Jae-sung.note: Watch Lee for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Also notice how Lee angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Lee Jae-sung.noteZh: Lee Jae-sung的优势在于等防守者注意力转移后再启动。最直接的表现是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Lee Kang-in.summary: Lee Kang-in is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Paris Saint-Germain who adds elite ball security, left-footed creation, and set-piece delivery.
Lee Kang-in.note: For Lee, the foundation is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Look first at how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Beyond the first action, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Lee Kang-in.noteZh: 最能体现Lee Kang-in特点的是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。这一点直接体现在他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。除此之外，他也会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Lee Tae-seok.summary: Lee Tae-seok is a South Korea left-back from Austria Wien who adds width, crossing range, and progressive carries down the flank.
Lee Tae-seok.note: Lee stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Also look at how Lee looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Lee Tae-seok.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下构成Lee Tae-seok踢法的核心。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。除此之外，值得留意他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Oh Hyeon-gyu.summary: Oh Hyeon-gyu is a South Korea centre-forward from Beşiktaş who adds strength, penalty-box movement, and direct finishing.
Oh Hyeon-gyu.note: Oh's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Watch how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Another detail is how he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Oh Hyeon-gyu.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动是理解Oh Hyeon-gyu踢法的关键。先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。到了另一个比赛环节，他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Paik Seung-ho.summary: Paik Seung-ho is a South Korea central midfielder from Birmingham City who adds deep passing, tempo control, and ball-winning balance.
Paik Seung-ho.note: For Paik, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Beyond the first action, he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Paik Seung-ho.noteZh: Paik Seung-ho的优势在于用传球的力度和角度移动防线。最直接的表现是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。另一个值得观察的细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Park Jin-seob.summary: Park Jin-seob is a South Korea defensive midfielder from Zhejiang FC who adds screening, centre-back cover, and aerial bite.
Park Jin-seob.note: The key to Park is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. There is another side to his game: he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Park Jin-seob.noteZh: Park Jin-seob最鲜明的特点是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。一个直接线索是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。另一个独立细节是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Seol Young-woo.summary: Seol Young-woo is a South Korea right-back from Red Star Belgrade who adds two-sided full-back cover, recovery speed, and attacking support.
Seol Young-woo.note: What separates Seol is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. Seol changes position while keeping his priorities simple. At another point, he turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Seol Young-woo.noteZh: 理解Seol Young-woo，要先看多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Son Heung-min.summary: Son Heung-min is South Korea's captain and Los Angeles FC forward, giving the national team elite movement, two-footed finishing, and transition threat.
Son Heung-min.note: What separates Son is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Son positions the ball to finish with either foot before the defender can reset. Also note how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Son Heung-min.noteZh: Son Heung-min最鲜明的特点是防线重组前制造干净射门。一个直接线索是他会把球放到左右脚都能直接射门的位置，在防守者重组前完成射门。另一个独立细节是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Song Bum-keun.summary: Song Bum-keun is a South Korea goalkeeper from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds shot-stopping depth, size, and domestic rhythm.
Song Bum-keun.note: Watch Song in two moments. First, check whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. Then watch whether he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Song Bum-keun.noteZh: 观察Song Bum-keun时，可以看两个时刻。先看他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。再看他是否会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Yang Hyun-jun.summary: Yang Hyun-jun is a South Korea winger from Celtic who adds direct dribbling, right-side speed, and one-on-one pressure.
Yang Hyun-jun.note: What separates Yang is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Yang draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. At another point, he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Yang Hyun-jun.noteZh: 理解Yang Hyun-jun，要先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。
